name: mathematicians-edge-documentary
description: The Mathematician's Edge: Jim Simons documentary (Remotion)

scripts.render: npm run sync:assets && remotion render Documentary out/the-mathematicians-edge.mp4
scripts.render:draft: npm run sync:assets && remotion render Documentary out/draft.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28 --props=props/draft.json
scripts.thumbnail: npm run sync:assets && remotion still Thumbnail out/thumbnail.png
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate
scripts.render:clean: npm run sync:assets && remotion render Documentary out/the-mathematicians-edge-no-subs.mp4 --props=props/clean.json
scripts.render:english: npm run sync:assets && remotion render Documentary out/the-mathematicians-edge-english.mp4 --props=props/english.json
